Properties.Pouw.why: the properties are stated against the code's own functions, on Lean core: nothing of Mathlib or of `security`

Properties.Pouw.Commit.why: the commitments' properties are stated against the port's own functions, on Lean core: nothing of Mathlib or of `security`

Properties.Nci.why: a property is stated over the definitions and the code it is about, never over a proof

Properties.CertifierDevice.why: the properties are stated against the device's own step and issuer, on Lean core: nothing of Mathlib or of `security`

reads_exempt.Flock: C-Flock is excepted until proofs extracts its spec (Daniel, 4 Oct 1:30 PM PDT): the check reads its `V`, `canon`, `hexOf` and `Sha512.hash`
reads_exempt.Randomness: core's randomness (`core_randomness`), read through PouwCommit: its lock declares no spec layer yet (draft #1499), so its definitions are recorded here as read rather than as a spec
